products.description_html:

The granite base adds natural beauty and enduring durability to a design that will last for many decades.

products.title: Como Black & White Bookends
products.description_html:
C’est Graphique!

A chic and chunky scallop-edged arc to keep your tomes from toppling. Featuring our mesmerizing twist on classic black and white, our acrylic Como bookends pair swirling tones with Memphis-y geometrics. Each piece is hand-poured to create a unique marbleized finish, then polished by hand for a luminous shine. A modern addition to any shelf.

Measurements

17.78 cm W, 8.89 cm D, 17.78 cm H
